findings.claim: FIX-ROUND-1.md CG-MAJ-001 closure summary misrepresents the escalation simplification scope, claiming the path was reduced to one step when the actual §8 line 188 retains three steps.
findings.evidence: FIX-ROUND-1.md §'From completeness_governance review' states: 'escalation step `(a) add them to CODEOWNERS` (was `(a) scp-break-glass team, (b) SCP-CODEOWNERS, (c) flip flag, (d) amend risk row`)' — unambiguously claiming a one-step result. The actual §8 line 188 reads: 'escalation path: when a second maintainer joins the estate, (a) add them to `CODEOWNERS`, (b) flip `require_review_from_non_author` to `true`, (c) amend this risk row to **[CLOSED]**' — three steps. This three-step path is consistent with §4 020K canonical spec at plan line 114 ('When a second maintainer onboards: add them to `CODEOWNERS`, flip `require_review_from_non_author=true`, amend §8 risk row to CLOSED'), confirming the three steps are the intended design. FIX-ROUND-1.md overclaimed the simplification rather than accurately describing the fix as 'corrected §8 to match the three-step escalation already specified in §4 020K'. The R2 dispatch verification criterion was authored based on FIX-ROUND-1.md's claim and also specifies one step, which the actual file does not satisfy.
findings.impact: The fix-round audit trail (FIX-ROUND-1.md) is inaccurate about what was changed. An agent or reviewer relying on FIX-ROUND-1.md to understand the delta would have a false picture of the §8 simplification scope. No operational regression: the actual three-step path is more complete and operationally correct (step (b) is needed to enable proper review enforcement; step (c) is the state-machine text that enables future CLOSED flips). The R2 verification criterion as written fails on this check; the discrepancy is in the documentation, not the live plan.
findings.mitigation: Update FIX-ROUND-1.md CG-MAJ-001 closure description to accurately state: 'Rewritten §8 line 188 to match the three-step escalation specified in §4 020K (line 114) — (a) add to CODEOWNERS, (b) flip require_review_from_non_author to true, (c) amend risk row to [CLOSED]. Removed stale scp-break-glass team language; the original §8 text had four steps where step (a) referenced a team that was never created.' One-line documentation fix; no code or plan-body change required.

findings.evidence: STATUS.md lines 58–65 show a four-row table with entries for D-021 (2026-05-31), bearer-legacy close (2026-09-30), 020K bus-factor-1 review (2026-07-21), and branch-protection quarterly review (2026-07-30). 'Phase 2 notice' at 2026-07-02 is absent. MEMORY.md line 7 lists all five dates including 'Phase 2 notice (2026-07-02)'.
